summary: PR-1430 raises the Fernbrook standard idle timeout from 30 to 45 minutes, in both Policy.java and the approved controls/mortgage/policy-params.json. The ticket, independent code review, approval-on-head and CI requirements are met, and the privileged 15-minute timeout is unaffected. However, the change alters an approved policy value under a protected controls path without the control_owner approval that CHG-6 requires. The change is therefore rejected.
